pricingFaq.title: FAQ
pricingFaq.q1: What are the limitations of the Free plan?
pricingFaq.a1: The Free plan supports 1 product group, up to 50 reviews per analysis, and analysis history retention of 7 days. Suitable for individual sellers to quickly try core features.
pricingFaq.q2: Is Pro billed monthly or annually?
pricingFaq.a2: Pro is currently available as a monthly subscription ($19/month / ~¥138), processed securely via Paddle worldwide. You can cancel anytime. Annual billing with discounts will be available later.
pricingFaq.q3: Will my existing data be preserved after upgrading?
pricingFaq.a3: All historical analysis data is automatically retained after upgrading, and the 7-day expiration limit is removed. No need to re-upload.
pricingFaq.a4: Major credit cards, PayPal, and other mainstream methods are supported through Paddle. Enterprise customers can contact us for annual contracts.
pricingFaq.q5: What's the minimum team size for the Team plan?
pricingFaq.a5: The Team plan starts at 3 people, customizable to your needs. Contact us for a custom quote and feature demo.
pricingFaq.q6: Can I downgrade or cancel anytime?
pricingFaq.a6: Yes. After downgrading, you'll still have Pro features until the end of the current billing cycle, then automatically revert to Free. No data is lost.

privacy.pageSubtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your data
privacy.lead: We respect and protect your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and how you can control your personal information.

items: Account Information: Username and email address provided during registration
Business Data: Product review content you upload, analysis results, and product profiles
Usage Data: Aggregated statistics such as feature usage frequency, quota consumption, and login times
Technical Data: IP address, browser type, and device information (for security purposes)
Delivering core services including review analysis, AI Q&A, and ad copy generation
Maintaining account security and service stability
Improving product features and user experience
Sending service-related notifications (e.g., quota reminders, system maintenance)

blocks.text: We do not sell your personal data. Third-party processing may occur in the following cases:

items: AI Analysis: Review content is sent to LLM providers (DeepSeek / OpenAI) for semantic analysis; only text content is transmitted without personally identifiable information
Payment Processing: Subscription payments are processed through Paddle, which independently handles payment information
Infrastructure: Data is stored on Supabase (PostgreSQL) and Alibaba Cloud ECS, both with industry-standard security measures
Legal Requirements: We may disclose necessary information when legally required

blocks.text: See the full sub-processor list at <link href="/sub-processors">/sub-processors</link>.

To improve analysis speed and reduce cost, when reviews you upload have identical content to reviews already analyzed by other users (matched via content hash), we may reuse the existing analysis results rather than calling the AI model again.

items: Reuse involves only anonymized analysis output (sentiment, aspect tags, opinion dimensions). No user identity, upload timestamp, or account information is shared across users.
Reuse does not affect your review quota — quota is consumed based on the number of reviews you upload, regardless of cache hits.
You may request data deletion via account settings; we will remove the raw reviews you uploaded within 30 days. Anonymized aggregated analysis results may be retained for service delivery.
Data is encrypted at rest and in transit using TLS/SSL
API keys are stored with AES/Fernet encryption and cannot be reversed
Row-Level Security (RLS) is implemented in the database, ensuring complete data isolation between users
Regular backups are stored encrypted in separate regions
Your data is retained for the duration of your account
All personal and business data will be deleted within 60 days after account deletion (60 days is the reversal window)
You may contact us at any time to request data export or deletion
Anonymized aggregate statistics (which cannot identify individuals) may be retained for service improvement

cookies.pageSubtitle: How ClueAI uses cookies and similar technologies
cookies.lead: This policy explains the cookies used by ClueAI's website and product, their purpose, and how you can manage them. ClueAI does not currently use third-party tracking or advertising cookies.

blocks.text: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser when you visit a website. They allow the site to "remember" state between pages (such as your sign-in or language preference) so you get a coherent experience.
ClueAI uses only the following strictly necessary session cookies:

items: session_token: Keeps you signed in; cleared on sign-out or when the browser is closed
NEXT_LOCALE: Remembers your interface language (Chinese / English); lifetime 1 year
csrf_token: Protects against cross-site request forgery; valid for the session

blocks.text: We do not use: advertising cookies, third-party tracking pixels, social media embed cookies, or cross-site behavioural analytics such as Google Analytics (_ga).

Because we only use strictly necessary session cookies (the "strictly necessary" category under the GDPR ePrivacy Directive), no consent banner is required in the EU/UK. If we ever introduce non-essential cookies (e.g. analytics or advertising), we will show a consent banner first and allow you to reject them.

California residents have the right to opt out of "the sale of my personal information" under CCPA. Because we do not use advertising cookies and do not sell data to third parties, no additional action is required.

items: You can clear or block all cookies at any time from your browser settings
Blocking session_token will prevent you from staying signed in
Blocking NEXT_LOCALE will cause the language preference to be re-negotiated on each visit
Blocking csrf_token will cause all form submissions to fail

blocks.text: Cookie management entry points in major browsers: Chrome "Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies and other site data"; Safari "Preferences → Privacy"; Firefox "Settings → Privacy & Security"; Edge "Settings → Cookies and site permissions".
This Cookie Policy is updated alongside the Privacy Policy. Any material change will be notified via email or in-app notification.
For cookie-related questions, please contact: <mail>privacy@clueai-reviewlens.com</mail>

dpa.pageSubtitle: GDPR Article 28 DPA for business customers
dpa.lead: This Data Processing Agreement ("DPA") supplements the Terms of Service between you and ClueAI. It applies when reviews you upload contain personal data of EU/UK residents and you, as the GDPR "Controller", instruct ClueAI as the "Processor" to process such data.

items: Controller: You (the ClueAI customer), who alone or jointly with others determines the purposes and means of processing personal data
Processor: ClueAI, processing personal data on behalf of the Controller
Sub-processor: A third party engaged by ClueAI; see /sub-processors
Personal Data: Any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person, as defined in GDPR Article 4(1)
Data Breach: A security incident causing accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorised disclosure of or access to personal data, as defined in GDPR Article 4(12)
Purpose: Providing you with review analysis, AI Q&A, ad copy generation, product comparison, and related services
Nature: Text content storage, AI model invocation, result generation, aggregated statistics
Data Types: Review text you upload, registered account information (email/username), usage logs
Data Subjects: Your end users (e.g. review authors), your staff accounts
Duration: The term of this DPA, or when you instruct deletion (whichever is earlier)
Process personal data only on the Controller's documented instructions (including this DPA and the Terms of Service)
Ensure that persons authorised to process the personal data are bound by confidentiality obligations
Take the technical and organisational security measures required by GDPR Article 32 (encryption, access control, backups, audit logging)
Assist the Controller in responding to data subject rights requests (access, rectification, erasure, portability), upon written request
Assist the Controller in fulfilling Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA) and prior consultation obligations under Articles 35–36, upon written request
Return or delete all personal data at the Controller's option upon termination or expiry of the contract (except where legally required to retain)

blocks.text: By accepting this DPA you give general authorisation for ClueAI to engage the sub-processors listed at <link href="/sub-processors">/sub-processors</link> as of the effective date of this DPA.

items: When adding or replacing a sub-processor, we update the public list 30 days in advance and notify enterprise DPA customers by email

If you have a reasonable objection to a new sub-processor, you may raise it in writing within 14 days of the notification; both parties will negotiate in good faith, and if unresolved you may terminate this DPA and receive a pro-rated refund
All sub-processors are bound by contractual terms equivalent to or stricter than this DPA

blocks.text: ClueAI's primary data storage is on Supabase (AWS ap-southeast-1, Singapore) and Alibaba Cloud ECS (Zhangjiakou). When personal data needs to be transferred from the EU/UK to these regions, we rely on the following legal mechanisms:

items: EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC 2021/914), Module 2 (Controller → Processor)
UK International Data Transfer Addendum (IDTA) as the UK equivalent of the SCCs
For sub-processors: see the DPA references for each provider listed at <link href="/sub-processors">/sub-processors</link>

blocks.text: Technical and organisational measures adopted by ClueAI include but are not limited to:

items: Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+ site-wide; API endpoints enforce HTTPS
Encryption at rest: Column-level encryption (AES-256) in the database; API keys encrypted with Fernet
Access control: Row-Level Security (RLS), principle of least privilege, two-factor authentication
Backups: Encrypted backups stored in a separate region, retained for 30 days
Audit logging: All sensitive operations logged, retained for at least 90 days
Staff training: Annual data protection and security awareness training
Notify you within 72 hours of becoming aware of a breach affecting your personal data
Notification includes: the nature of the breach, the estimated categories and number of affected subjects, likely consequences, and mitigation measures taken and planned
Cooperate with your obligation to report to supervisory authorities

blocks.text: You have the right (at your own expense) to appoint an independent third-party auditor to audit ClueAI's compliance with this DPA no more than once every 12 months, on 30 days' prior written notice. The audit scope is limited to processing activities under this DPA, and the auditor must sign a confidentiality agreement.

Liability under this DPA is subject to the limitation of liability clauses in the Terms of Service. If applicable law imposes a higher standard (such as GDPR Article 82 data subject damages), that law prevails.

items: This DPA takes effect upon your acceptance and remains in force alongside the Terms of Service
